requirement.statement: depa-data-depa-orm-domain-runtime SHALL declare production dependencies by package name, compile read-only Kon model sources through the depa-orm-dsl-kon public root, explicitly project public compilation properties into current storage-neutral root contracts, and prove public compose/assemble/SQLite Writer/Reader operation from its own package environment; it SHALL reject halfcode, dist, node_modules, capsule paths, casts of legacy schema, and non-allowlisted depa-orm subpaths.

case.given: root install has run and runtime package declares all production dependencies
case.when: a smoke imports each dependency by package name from runtime package cwd
case.then: all imports resolve without capsule or external source-relative paths

case.given: a read-only Kon source defining an entity and fields
case.when: compile, explicit projection, SQLite initialize, public Writer create, and public Reader query run
case.then: the created row is read back and registry destroy completes using only allowed exports
halfcode, dist, node_modules, capsule paths, source-relative external imports, and unallowlisted subpaths are absent

requirement.statement: The runtime SHALL validate and freeze a stateless DomainContextBundle whose static catalog and complete preset requests remain separate from server current capability projection; exact request, preset/catalog, one-definition batch, and definition/binding/server capability preflight SHALL complete before SQLite allocation, seed, or handler execution; every accepted execute call SHALL own create-initialize-seed-execute-observe-destroy with a fresh in-memory SQLite registry, consecutive and concurrent calls SHALL not share data, and compile/initialize/seed/handler/probe failures SHALL still complete destroy before return.

case.given: a static catalog with complete presets, seed, operation bindings with actual capability sets, and probes
case.then: ids, refs, preset parity, and binding capability subsets are validated; preset requests are frozen unchanged; the loaded definition contains no server projection, connection, transaction, or last execution state

case.given: an exact, preset/catalog, mixed batch, or capability-intersection mismatch
case.then: structured diagnostics return before SQLite allocation, seed, or handler side effects

case.given: the same loaded bundle is executed with two different server current capability projections
case.then: the static catalog and complete presets remain unchanged and only the per-execution capability verdict differs

case.given: the same seeded bundle and mutation preset
case.then: both executions observe the same before state and equivalent result
their database state and lifecycle ids remain independent

case.given: a failure at compile, initialize, seed, handler, or probe stage
case.then: destroy has completed and a later fresh execution succeeds

requirement.statement: The runtime SHALL parse and catalog-match the exact request, dispatch only by operation.ref, preserve single/selection/batch semantics, require every batch item to match one definition verb and subject shape, validate request choices against definition requestable ∩ binding actual ∩ server current, wrap same-datasource atomic work in the public outer transaction, reject cross-datasource atomic work before handlers, and isolate homogeneous best-effort batch items without silently changing requested atomicity.

case.given: an unknown operation ref or exact request, preset, dimensions, verb, or batch shape inconsistent with catalog
case.then: no SQLite allocation, seed, or handler runs and stable validation diagnostics identify the path

case.given: a request choice excluded by the definition, binding, or server current capability set
case.then: the failing authority is reported and no SQLite allocation, seed, or handler runs

case.given: a composed handler performs two public Writer calls on one datasource and the second fails
case.then: the outer transaction rolls both writes back and response reports failure

case.given: a binding declares multiple datasources and request atomicity is atomic
case.then: CROSS_DATASOURCE_ATOMICITY_REJECTED is returned before any handler runs

case.given: homogeneous independently keyed batch items where one handler invocation fails
case.then: successful siblings commit, response is partial, and item keys map to independent statuses

requirement.statement: The response SHALL truthfully normalize handler outcome, mutation effects, requested before/after/diff probes, operation child tree, public plan/stage projections, and diagnostics; unavailable storage row mapping or SQL trace SHALL be explicit and SHALL NOT fabricate item rows or SQL statements.

case.given: a write handler and declared probe
case.when: before, after, and diff are requested
case.then: snapshots show real seeded and committed states and diff identifies the change

case.given: a parent handler invokes registered children and uses Reader/Writer
case.then: operation tree preserves child refs and plan/stages contain only JSON-safe public projections

case.given: SQL observation or required storage row-level mapping is unavailable
case.then: SQL_TRACE_UNAVAILABLE or BATCH_ITEM_MAPPING_UNAVAILABLE is present without fabricated SQL or item rows
